description: A 30-iteration diagnostic at 1% that exists only to test whether the ride-availability binding changes behaviour, by comparing the ride trajectory against the recorded pre-fix baseline (ride = 0.3098 at iteration 25, DECISIONS.md 9.10). NOT A RESULT: 30 iterations is two orders of magnitude short of relaxation.

justification.RUN.controler.last_iteration: The sweep starts at 250 because that is the largest value MEASURED to be insufficient for convergence, so the range describes candidate MODELLING runs. This is a behavioural regression test against a recorded baseline at iteration 25, not a modelling run, and the value is deliberately far below the range so any output is obviously not a result.
